pairs: In gutture tuo sit tuba quasi aquila super domum Domini,
Let there be a trumpet in your throat,
pro eo quod transgressi sunt fœdus meum,
like an eagle over the house of the Lord,
on behalf of those who have transgressed my covenant and violated my law.
and I did not recognize them.
et aurum suum fecerunt sibi idola,
they have made into idols for themselves,
so that they might cross over.
Your calf, Samaria, has been rejected.
Samaria; iratus est furor meus in eos.
My fury has been enraged against them.
How long will they be incapable of being cleansed?
Quia ex Israël et ipse est:
For it is itself also from Israel:
quoniam in aranearum telas erit vitulus Samariæ.
For the calf of Samaria will be used for the webs of spiders.
culmus stans non est in eo;
It does not have a firm stalk;
the bud will yield no grain.
nunc factus est in nationibus quasi vas immundum.
Now, among the nations, it has become like an unclean vessel.
For they have gone up to Assur,
a wild ass alone by himself.
Ephraim has given presents to his lovers.
Sed et cum mercede conduxerint nationes,
But even when they will have brought the nations together for the sake of money,
et quiescent paulisper ab onere regis et principum.
And they will rest for a little while from the burden of the king and the leaders.
Quia multiplicavit Ephraim altaria ad peccandum;
For Ephraim multiplied altars to sin,
factæ sunt ei aræ in delictum.
and sanctuaries have become an offense for him.
I will write to him my intricate laws,
which have been treated like strangers.
they will immolate flesh and will eat,
and the Lord will not accept them.
For now he will remember their iniquity,
and he will repay their sins:
they will be turned back to Egypt.
Et oblitus est Israël factoris sui,
And Israel has forgotten his Maker
And Judah has increased its fortified cities.
et mittam ignem in civitates ejus,
And I will send fire upon his cities,
and it will devour its structures.
